Azer are a type of Elemental creature and non-playable race in Baldur's Gate 3.
“
Master craftsmen and expert miners made from bronze and fire.
„
— In-game racial description

Involvement

Azer can be summoned using the spell  Conjure Minor Elemental: Azer.

Combat

Attacks and actions

 Main Hand Attack ()   –  Azer Warhammer
Damage: 5~17
1d8 + 3⁠Bludgeoning
+ 1d6⁠Fire
Make a melee attack with your equipped weapon.
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Overheat ()
Damage: 1~10
1d10⁠Fire
Release a fraction of your inner fire. All nearby creatures take damage and start  Burning Fiercely.
 CON Save
 Range: Self
 Searing Smite ()   –  Azer Warhammer
Damage: 7~29
1d8 + 3⁠Bludgeoning
+ 1d6⁠Fire
+ 1d6⁠Fire
+ 1d6⁠Fire
Your weapon flares with white-hot intensity. It deals, on top of weapon damage, an extra 1d6Fire damage and marks the target with  Searing Smite.
 CON Save
 Melee: 1.5 m (5 ft)
 Recharge: Once per battle

Equipment

  • Azer Warhammer
  • Shield

Gallery

  • Concept art by Jane Katsubo

Notes

  • The other options for  Conjure Minor Elemental summon creatures of level 7, but the summoned azer remains at level 1. The primary implication of this is that the azer's proficiency bonus is 2 instead of 3. Therefore its attack rolls are lower.
